fact: The DGE and ONECI signed a convention making data of the registre national des personnes physiques the sole official source of voter identification data for the biometric electoral file, as the DGE director-general states.

L'Independant quotes the elections directorate head saying the voter roll will be fed from the national register of natural persons (RNPP) by an annual extraction of citizens aged 18 holding a birth record.
Prime Minister Amadou Oury Bah, at the 27 November 2025 launch of the civil service file FUGAS, stressed that each citizen's Numero d'Identification Unique must in future be integrated into FUGAS.
